        <script type="application/json">
            {
            "vars": {
            "gtag_id": "UA-6084692-22",
                "config": {
                  "UA-6084692-22": { "groups": "default", "site_speed_sample_rate": 100 }
                }
            },
            "requests": {
                "setPoCookie": "https://priceoye.pk/set_priceoye_cookie?referer=https://priceoye.pk/service-worker.js&"
            },
            "triggers": {
            "setPriceoyeCookie": {
            "on": "visible",
            "request": "setPoCookie"
            },
            "trackPageview": {
            "on": "visible",
            "request": "pageview"
            },
            "trackClick" : {
            "on": "click",
            "selector": ".ga-dataset",
            "request": "event",
            "vars": {

            "event_category": "fLog:${categoryId}:${categoryName}",
            "event_name": "${location}",
            "event_label": "${page}:${location}#${value}"
            }
            },
            "trackStoreClick" : {
            "on": "click",
            "selector": ".ga-dataset-store",
            "request": "event",
            "vars": {
            "event_category": "${categoryId}:${categoryName}",
            "event_name": "${storeId}:${flavorId}:${storePosition}:${storeLink}",
            "event_label": "${productId}:${productLink}",
            "value": "${productPrice}"
            }
            }

            }
            }
         </script>
    </amp-analytics>

        <script type="application/json">
            {
            "vars": {
            "gtag_id": "UA-6084692-22",
                "config": {
                  "UA-6084692-22": { "groups": "default", "site_speed_sample_rate": 100 }
                }
            },
            "requests": {
                "setPoCookie": "https://priceoye.pk/set_priceoye_cookie?referer=https://priceoye.pk/service-worker.js&"
            },
            "triggers": {
            "setPriceoyeCookie": {
            "on": "visible",
            "request": "setPoCookie"
            },
            "trackPageview": {
            "on": "visible",
            "request": "pageview"
            },
            "trackClick" : {
            "on": "click",
            "selector": ".ga-dataset",
            "request": "event",
            "vars": {

            "event_category": "fLog:${categoryId}:${categoryName}",
            "event_name": "${location}",
            "event_label": "${page}:${location}#${value}"
            }
            },
            "trackStoreClick" : {
            "on": "click",
            "selector": ".ga-dataset-store",
            "request": "event",
            "vars": {
            "event_category": "${categoryId}:${categoryName}",
            "event_name": "${storeId}:${flavorId}:${storePosition}:${storeLink}",
            "event_label": "${productId}:${productLink}",
            "value": "${productPrice}"
            }
            }

            }
            }
         </script>
